## Failures (FAIL state)
  83/1000 = 8.3%
    81  InvalidIndexError: Reindexing only valid with uniquely valued Index objects
     2  TypeError: Cannot compare tz-naive and tz-aware timestamps

  Root cause: pandas concurrency on shared feature DataFrame indexes
  with n_jobs=4 threading. featured_data dicts are read concurrently;
  pandas Index._engine hash cache is built lazily on first .loc access
  and is not thread-safe to construct from multiple threads simultaneously.
  Workaround for a follow-up segment: pre-warm engines in
  _load_shared_data (one .loc per ticker) before trials start. Doesn't
  block this study's signal -- 834 valid scored trials are
  plenty for TPE.
